note: Congress tracker for the Profession part, three lanes in one list. kind = bill (stages introduced, committee, house, senate, conference, enacted; status 'stalled' or 'vetoed' greys the pipeline), budget (stages request, house, senate, cr, enacted, plus a deadline date), nomination (stages vacant, announced, nominated, hearing, committee, floor, confirmed, or withdrawn). dates holds the date each stage was reached. The run adds rows for key defence bills, the appropriations cycle and defence posts (service secretaries and chiefs, Joint Staff, combatant and NATO commanders, OSD, ambassadors to NATO and the host nations), moves stage and dates as Congress acts, sets updated, copies cited source rows into src, and never deletes rows (the page hides enacted, confirmed and withdrawn rows after 30 days). Deadlines feed the Planner.
